description: Proposed rear dormer and 2 No. rooflights, reinstatement of brick chimney stack and external condenser unit
decision_conditions: <p>The development hereby approved shall ensure that the rating level of noise emissions from the&nbsp;external condenser unit does not exceed 10dB below the background noise level when assessed in accordance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019.</p><p>Should any changes to the approved plant or equipment occur, a noise assessment must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate compliance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019.</p><p>REASON: To safeguard the amenity of neighbouring occupiers and ensure compliance with Policy LP2 of Hackney’s Local Plan and the London Plan’s strategic noise policies.</p>

<p>Prior to occupation, at least 1 bird/bat box shall be provided below eaves level at the development hereby approved and thereafter retained.&nbsp;</p><p>REASON: In the interests of improvements to biodiversity.</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>Works to reinstate the chimney (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type of brick, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture, unless otherwise first agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; The works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.&nbsp;</p><p>REASON: In the interest of the Conservation Area</p>
